use default

is_valid_iban(raw: string) -> bool is
    let iban =
        raw |> filter(ch => ch != ' ') |> map(ch => "{ch}") |> join("")

    let is_letter = (ch: char) => ch >= 'A' /\ ch <= 'Z'

    if iban.length < 4 \/ !is_letter(iban[0]) \/ !is_letter(iban[1]) then
        return false
    fi

    let rearranged = "{iban[4..<0]}{iban[0..4]}"

    let letter_value = (ch: char) => "{cast int(ch) - cast int('A') + 10}"
    let numeric = rearranged
        |> map(ch => if is_letter(ch) then letter_value(ch) else "{ch}" fi)
        |> join("")

    let remainder mut = 0

    for ch in numeric do
        remainder = (remainder * 10 + (cast int(ch) - cast int('0'))) % 97
    od

    remainder == 1
